user.title: Hughes Power Watchdog
user.description: Select a discovered Hughes Power Watchdog device or enter its Bluetooth MAC address manually.

confirm.title: Configure {name}
confirm.description:
A Hughes Power Watchdog was discovered:

**{name}** ({generation})

Do you want to add it to Home Assistant?

init.title: Bluetooth adapter
init.description: The Watchdog keeps a Bluetooth connection open all the time, so it uses a connection slot on whichever adapter or proxy it connects through. Home Assistant picks that by signal strength, which can put too many held connections on one adapter. Choose one here to spread them out yourself. The Bluetooth Path sensor shows the one in use.

data.adapter_fallback: Use another adapter if this one is unavailable

data_description.adapter: Automatic lets Home Assistant choose. Adapters and proxies that hear the Watchdog right now are listed first, strongest first.
data_description.adapter_fallback: Only used when the chosen adapter hasn't heard the Watchdog recently or has no free slot.
